scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of every claimed dimension and taper; exact rational and independent finite matrix tests are supplementary. Independent validation not undertaken.
scientific_limitations: Only graph-distance exponential windows, two adjacent translations and the index-two modulation subgroup on even finite cycles. No arbitrary-window or alternative-lattice optimum claimed; older equivalent treatments may exist.
title: Exact optimal taper and quadratic conditioning for a cyclic exponential Gabor basis
